function wrongPrimitive(value: { length: number }) {
  if (typeof value === "number") return value.toFixed();
}
function wrongBoxedGuard(value: String) {
  if (typeof value === "number") return value.toFixed();
}
function unrelated(value: RegExp) {
  if (typeof value === "string") return value.toUpperCase();
}
function generic<T extends { toString(): string }>(value: T) {
  if (typeof value === "string") return value.toUpperCase();
  if (typeof value === "object") return value.toString();
  return value.toString();
}
function boundedUnion<T extends string | number>(value: T) {
  if (typeof value === "bigint") return value.toString();
}
